summary: ACDC #188 把 quick slots（EIP-8198）和禁止新 0x00 验证者（EIP-8365）列为 Hegotá 的 CFI，撤回 EIP-8363 与 EIP-8333，拒绝 EIP-8379。FOCIL devnet-0 上线。账户侧，lightclient 尝试在 frame 对象中引入 `max_fee`，代替按维度的资源上限，思路借鉴 EIP-7999。zk.money 在 Aztec 上推出私密、自托管、开源的钱包，EF 公开祝贺。

summary_en: ACDC #188 moved quick slots (EIP-8198) and disallowing new 0x00 validators (EIP-8365) to CFI for Hegotá, withdrew EIP-8363 and EIP-8333, and declined EIP-8379. FOCIL devnet-0 went live. On accounts, lightclient tried introducing `max_fee` to the frame object instead of per-dimension resource limits, adapted from EIP-7999. zk.money launched a private, self-custodial, open source wallet on Aztec, and the EF congratulated it publicly.
